Sandbox_HARMONIE_ProtectionDamageMultipl: Multiplies how much condition Standardized Vehicle Upgrades 3's own protection/armor parts (bullbars, window/door/trunk armor, wheel chains) lose each time they absorb damage for the vehicle part they protect. 1.0 = SVU3's own unmodified values. Higher = they break down faster from use.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_MaxInstallSkillTotal: Max total skill to install an upgrade
Sandbox_HARMONIE_MaxInstallSkillTotal_to: The skill levels one SVU3 upgrade needs to install (e.g. welding + mechanics) add up to at most this, after the vehicle tier. An upgrade that needs more has its highest skill lowered until it fits. SVU3's own highest is 14 (the plows).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_VehicleTierScaling_tool: Cars SVU3 can upgrade are ranked by weight and front/rear end strength and split into tiers. Bigger, tougher cars need SVU3's own skill levels to install upgrades; smaller cars need less (see the two options below). The tiers are listed in console.txt when the game starts.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_VehicleTierCount_toolti: How many tiers the cars are split into. The top tier uses SVU3's own install skill levels.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_VehicleTierLowestPercen: The install skill levels of the lowest tier, as a percent of SVU3's own. The tiers between go up evenly to 100%%. Levels are rounded and never below 1.
